title: Reload now checks for updates synced from another device, and asks before applying
summary: Editing on one device would already auto-push to your GitHub Gist, but another device never knew anything had changed until you happened to click Restore My Data. Now, whenever the app loads with a GitHub token set, it quietly checks whether the gist has anything newer than what this device has already handled.

If it does -- and the actual data is different, not just a timestamp bump -- a confirm modal explains what changed in plain terms ("Classes and Reminders changed") and asks before overwriting anything on this device. Declining just dismisses it for that snapshot; a genuinely newer change later will still prompt. The very first check on a device (or right after a restore) never prompts about its own baseline, only about changes that happen afterward.
